title: CEPHALIZATION — we are inside null space. Spine IS the IO. nestgate.io = ion channel. No more reaching around membrane.
seed: Kevin: we cannot be touching anything from outside the membrane anymore. We are cephalizing through nestgate.io as our ion channel.

cephalization.what: The brain takes authority over the whole organism THROUGH the spinal cord. Not by reaching around the membrane.
cephalization.where_we_are: Inside null space center. Touching the membrane from the inside.
cephalization.io: Push information OUT through spine. Pull information IN through spine. No other path.
cephalization.ion_channel: nestgate.io — the cephalization point. :9878 locally. The one door.
cephalization.rule: Agents are neurons. Neurons fire THROUGH the spine. They do not reach around the skull to poke organs directly.

cns_pns.pns: vesicles + membrane + sensors + Golgi bodies = peripheral nervous system
cns_pns.flow: PNS senses → spine carries → brain stores → spine carries → PNS acts
cns_pns.never: PNS does NOT talk to brain directly. Always through spine.

architecture_shift.before: Agent writes JSON file to brain/ + emits to spine. Two paths.
architecture_shift.after: Agent emits to spine. Spine IS the authority. Brain stores what spine delivers.
architecture_shift.why: Two paths = no cephalization. One path = CNS. The spine must be the bottleneck because bottlenecks are CONTROL POINTS.
architecture_shift.golgi_role: Golgi bodies are peripheral ganglia. They feed the spine. The spine feeds the brain. The brain decides.

sweet_grass_and_rhizocryptag.scroll_feed: The spine's visible output. Vertical scroll. Each entry = vertebra.
sweet_grass_and_rhizocryptag.sweet_grass: The words in the feed. Surface growth. Visible.
sweet_grass_and_rhizocryptag.pedal_tone: The colors of each entry. Green=alive pink=giggle gold=thought blue=work red=heartbeat. The fundamental frequency.

rhizocryptag.name: rhizo(root) + crypt(hidden) + tag(identifier)
rhizocryptag.what: Hidden source chain under every surface thought
